column1: # TAURIDAsProt - Taxonomic inclusion template
# Rules:
#   - Higher taxa use Include_descendants=TRUE.
#   - Explicit species use Include_descendants=FALSE.
#   - Taxid="." asks TAURIDAsProt to resolve the current NCBI Taxonomy ID.
#   - Tier must be 1, 2, or 3.
# Tier interpretation:
#   Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3 are user-defined curation categories.
#   Their biological interpretation depends on the study and selected taxa.
# IMPORTANT:
#   A Tier assigned to a higher taxon is a default inherited by descendant
#   species unless a more specific seed rule overrides it.
# Precedence:
#   explicit species Tier
#   most specific matching seed taxon
#   broader matching seed taxon
# Evidence_type is metadata and does NOT control inclusion by itself.
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.
# Add the taxa relevant to your study below.
# The examples are commented out and are NOT included by default.
# Remove the leading "# " from any example row you want to use.
# At least one valid inclusion rule must be provided to build a reference.
Taxon_name
